{{Top|leg}}
A '''gravity sensor''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. It could measure the [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] of a local environment in relation to standard gravity. Gravity sensors could be installed in [[Chronometer/Legends|chronometers]] such as the [[MicroThrust Processors|MicroThrust]] [[Clockwatcher]] for an extra ten [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
